descriptions.rgb: A narrow, wet soil path runs forward between dense rows of rose bushes, with red and pink flowers extending from below camera level to roughly chest height. One adult in a green shirt and dark shorts stands about 1–2 m ahead, initially near the center-right and later occupying the right side at roughly 0.5–1 m; the person is partly cropped above the shoulders in every frame. The person faces mostly away from or across the camera wearer rather than directly toward them, and their head and gaze are not visible. Rose stems and flowers lie within arm’s reach on both sides of the camera wearer and also beside the person, while the person and nearby bushes increasingly occlude the path and plants on the right. Across the five frames, the camera wearer moves forward and slightly right toward the person, who shifts from farther ahead to very close on the right and turns somewhat sideways; in the final frame, the camera wearer’s hand enters at the lower right within reach of a rose stem and the person’s blue-handled object.
